mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT e.shop_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(sh.poi_id), ''), CAST(e.shop_id AS CHAR)) AS poi_id, COALESCE(MAX(sh.poi_name), MAX(sh.name), MAX(e.shop_name_snapshot)) AS shop_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(sh.contact_phone), ''), NULLIF(MAX(sh.phone), ''), NULLIF(MAX(e.shop_phone_snapshot), '')) AS shop_phone, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_APP_OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_app_open_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'ADMIN_BACKEND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pc_master_console_operation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_CONFIG_BUTTON_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_config_button_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_UNLOCK_AI_PEAK_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_unlock_ai_peak_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_CONFIG_MODAL_CONFIRM_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_config_modal_confirm_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_CONFIG_MODAL_CANCEL_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_config_modal_cancel_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_POWER_TAB_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_power_tab_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_LOG_TAB_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_log_tab_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_SUPPORT_TAB_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_support_tab_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_RECHARGE_GIF_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_recharge_gif_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_POWER_PAY_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_power_pay_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_REDEMPTION_CODE_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_redemption_code_click_count FROM user_behavior_event e LEFT JOIN mt_shop sh ON sh.id = e.shop_id WHERE e.event_time >= #{startAt} AND e.event_time < #{endAt}
GROUP BY e.shop_id ) stats

choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_user_shop_binding usb WHERE usb.shop_id = e.shop_id )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_sales_user_shop_binding usb WHERE usb.shop_id = e.shop_id )

sql.if: AND ( CAST(e.shop_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(sh.poi_id, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(sh.epoi_id, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(sh.poi_name, sh.name, e.shop_name_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(sh.contact_phone, ''), NULLIF(sh.phone, ''), NULLIF(e.shop_phone_snapshot, ''), '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

when.test: sortColumn != null and sortColumn != '' and sortDirection == 'ASC'
sortColumn != null and sortColumn != '' and sortDirection == 'DESC'

choose.otherwise: ORDER BY h5_app_open_count DESC, shop_id DESC
